title: English Vocabulary - Synonyms & Best Expressed Words

questions.question: Which word is a synonym of 'Barbarian'?
'Cajole' means the same as:
questions.rationale: 'Cajole' (खुशामद करना / मनाना) is synonymous with Coax or Flatter.

questions.question: Which phrasal verb means 'to investigate'?
questions.rationale: 'Look into' (जाँच करना) means to investigate, as distinct from 'Look after' (take care of) or 'Look for' (search).

questions.question: 'Laconic' most nearly means:
questions.rationale: 'Laconic' (कम बोलने वाला / संक्षिप्त) means Concise, Brief, or Short.

questions.question: 'Affluent' means the same as:
questions.rationale: 'Affluent' (समृद्ध / धनी) means Rich or Wealthy; 'Destitute' is its opposite meaning Poor.

questions.question: 'Curtail' means to:
questions.rationale: 'Curtail' (कम करना) means Reduce, Decrease, or Diminish.

questions.question: Which phrasal verb means 'to take care of'?
questions.rationale: 'Look after' (देखभाल करना) means to take care of; 'Look into' means investigate and 'Look for' means search.

questions.question: 'Forlorn' describes someone who is:
questions.rationale: 'Forlorn' means Lonely, sad, or abandoned; 'Crafty/Cunning' means Clever, sly.

questions.question: 'Opaque' is the opposite of:
questions.rationale: 'Transparent' (पारदर्शी) means Clear, while 'Opaque' (अपारदर्शी) means Non-transparent — they are opposites.
